checks.description: Server correctly verifies valid HMAC-SHA256 signature calculated from order_id|payment_id.
Server rejects forged or tampered payment signature.
Server rejects signature if order ID does not match the signed token.

checks.checkName: Razorpay Webhook Raw Body HMAC Verification
checks.description: Server correctly verifies X-Razorpay-Signature using the exact raw body string.
Server rejects webhook when request body has been modified after signature calculation.
Replaying completed payment notifications does not duplicate monetary totals or supporter count.
Server authoritatively enforces item unit prices and total calculation.
Signature comparison must use crypto.timingSafeEqual to prevent side-channel timing attacks.
Razorpay Key Secret and Webhook Secret must NOT have NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix, preventing client bundling.
Server strictly rejects refund initiation from unauthorized roles and accepts authorized finance/admin roles.
checks.details: Unauthorized roles rejected, authorized finance roles accepted.
